        elif byte & 0xF0 == 0xE0:  # 3-byte character

        elif byte & 0xF8 == 0xF0:  # 4-byte character
            char_len = 4
        else:
            # invalid leading byte
            raise ValueError("Invalid UTF-8 byte")

            # incomplete character, cannot include

        # Check if adding this character exceeds max_bytes

            break
        # Otherwise, add it
